question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Final query: distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match for the losing team
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        player_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(runs_scored, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, player_id
    HAVING SUM(COALESCE(runs_scored, 0)) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pmr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
